title: NGA — Map of the World (MoW) Modernization
goal: Align UX strategy with platform outcomes; provide artifacts that accelerate delivery.
summary: Reimagined task flows, architecture, onboarding, and admin configuration to reduce friction and improve decision speed in a complex multi-team platform.

sections.title: Context & Scope
sections.body: Enterprise geospatial platform with cross-team dependencies and modernization goals. Led wireframes/flows for core tasks (desktop/mobile, admin/user surfaces), set UX→DevOps feedback path, and introduced a scalable prioritization schema.

sections.title: What I Led
sections.body:
• Designed centralized feedback loop routing user signals to engineering.
• Authored data calls and questionnaires for meaningful, actionable insight.
• Created onboarding wizard and admin theming to focus workspaces on the next workflow.
• Facilitated leadership workshops; introduced outcome scorecards for priority alignment.

sections.title: Results
sections.body: Clearer task pathways and faster alignment on priorities; improved readiness for implementation.

artifacts.caption: Core task flows and admin controls
